items.en_title: Microsoft Data Shows Claude Is Stalling Against Copilot in Office - The Information
items.en_oneliner: Microsoft's internal data shows Claude's progress in office applications is stalling, leaving it unable to challenge Copilot's lead.

items.title: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics
items.en_title: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics
items.en_oneliner: Training an AI model requires thousands of GPUs working together, and Lambda is using NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics to tackle the networking speed and reliability challenge.

items.title: NVIDIA Expands Slurm to Bring Quantum Computing Into Supercomputing
items.en_title: NVIDIA Expands Slurm to Bring Quantum Computing Into Supercomputing
items.en_oneliner: As quantum processor deployments at supercomputing centers grew nearly sevenfold in five years, Nvidia extended Slurm to quantum computing so quantum and classical systems can be scheduled together.

items.title: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
items.en_title: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
items.en_oneliner: In its MLPerf debut the Vera Rubin platform led across training, post-training and agentic inference, with NVIDIA sweeping every category.

items.title: NVIDIA CUDA-X Libraries Give Agents the Tools to Accelerate Scientific Discovery
items.en_title: NVIDIA CUDA-X Libraries Give Agents the Tools to Accelerate Scientific Discovery
items.en_oneliner: The expanded CUDA-X libraries help researchers sift through massive datasets faster in fields like astrophysics and materials science, and agents can call these tools directly.

items.title: CUDA at 20: How the Platform Transformed Scientific Computing
items.en_title: CUDA at 20: How the Platform Transformed Scientific Computing
items.en_oneliner: Nvidia marked CUDA's 20th anniversary at SC26, looking back at how it grew from graphics computing into a foundation of modern science and AI.

items.title: NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC — A New GPU to Accelerate Agents for Science, Engineering and Analytics
items.en_title: NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC — A New GPU to Accelerate Agents for Science, Engineering and Analytics
items.en_oneliner: The new GPU in the Vera Rubin platform targets simulation and data processing, aiming to make agents faster in science and engineering workflows.
